verdict.rationale: Docs show strong support for cloud/background agents that plan, code, test, and open PRs (docs-2,3,13,14,26), plus remote control/teleport for review-anywhere workflows (docs-9,10). However, no dedicated 'demo' artifact and community reports of unreliable self-verification, regressions, and failure modes on real tasks (comm-16,17,19,20) temper confidence in consistent end-to-end delivery.
